note: Hand corrections applied by build_knows.py to the blocks in work/knows_out: 'retag' moves a 'when' entry of that NPC with quest+state to to_quest+to_state; 'secret' ties that NPC's secret to a quest stage, so it is only used then; 'also' gives a 'when' entry a second condition (also_quest + also_state; 'war_side' = the side the player joined, Legion or Stormcloaks); 'tie' ties an untied line (the one starting with 'starts') to quest states ('secret:<state>' keeps it a secret then).
